card.title: PACTGuard
card.subtitle: Pre-Release Compliance Middleware for AI-Era Financial Communications
card.summary: RegTech middleware that reviews AI-generated financial communications and robo-advice before release. Compares three independent engines (deterministic rules, semantic retrieval, and a Gemini AI judge), then applies a Pass / Adjust / Check / Terminate decision with an evidence-bound explanation. Built for the Cambridge Spark 'Financial Regulation in an AI-Driven World' challenge.

detail.overview: PACTGuard is pre-release compliance middleware and a regulatory sandbox for customer-facing financial communications. It checks AI-generated, AI-assisted, and human-written promotional, chatbot, CRM, and robo-advice outputs before they reach customers, applies a Pass / Adjust / Check / Terminate release decision, and produces an evidence-bound Evidence Pack for firms and regulator-style reviewers. Built by team PACTful for the Cambridge Spark 'Financial Regulation in an AI-Driven World' challenge, it is FCA-aligned, not FCA-certified, and does not provide financial or legal advice or imply regulatory approval.

contentCards.markdown:
### Architecture
- **Three independent engines, compared:** deterministic keyword/context rules, semantic xRAG reference retrieval (`sentence-transformers` `all-MiniLM-L6-v2` + cosine similarity), and a Gemini 2.0 Flash AI judge, with a deterministic *simulated* fallback when no API key is present.
- **Hybrid PACT release gate** combines scoring, severe-risk overrides, session escalation, and engine disagreement into a final Pass / Adjust / Check / Terminate decision.
- **Backend:** Django + Django REST Framework, SQLite, a metadata-wrapped control library (`controls.json`), and a service layer (`risk_engine`, `retrieval`, `scoring`, `pact_gate`, `evidence_pack`, `xai`, `sandbox`, `audit`).
- **Frontend:** React + Vite single-page app for review, sandbox comparison, and dashboards.
- **Version-controlled middleware:** every decision is stamped with the control-library version; publishing a new version flags prior decisions as needing reassessment.

### Features
- **Evidence Packs:** every finding links a flagged phrase (or absent disclosure) to a control ID, the regulation reference, why it matters, and a remediation hint. No explanation without evidence.
- **Safe failure:** when required context is missing or the engines materially disagree on consumer-harm risk, PACTGuard defaults to **Check** for human review rather than silently releasing content.
- **Session & customer risk:** optional session and customer tracking so repeated risky outputs escalate instead of disappearing as isolated events.
- **Robo-advice controls:** distinguishes controlled, well-evidenced personalised advice from unsuitable recommendations (suitability evidence, customer-interest alignment, reviewable rationale).
- **Governance & regulator dashboards:** decision distribution, top triggered controls, engine-disagreement rate, explanation quality, and audit completeness.

problem.title: Challenge: Releasing AI-Generated Financial Comms Safely at Scale
problem.issue: AI can produce financial messages across chatbots, marketing, CRM, apps, and social media faster than compliance teams can manually review them.
problem.impact: Manual review of every message does not scale, but uncontrolled release creates consumer-harm, auditability, and governance risk.

solution.title: Solution: A Pre-Release PACT Gate
solution.implementation: Communications pass through intake and context capture, the engines, scoring, and a release gate that converts risk into a Pass / Adjust / Check / Terminate action, with each decision accompanied by an Evidence Pack and audit record.
solution.result: Firms get a proportionate, evidence-backed release decision and an audit trail before a message reaches customers, instead of all-or-nothing manual review.

problem.title: Challenge: Black-Box AI Decisions in a Regulated Context
problem.issue: A single AI verdict with no rationale is unusable for compliance, because reviewers and regulators need to see why a message was flagged and how confident the basis is.
problem.impact: Opaque decisions create liability and erode trust; reviewers cannot act on conclusions they cannot audit.

solution.title: Solution: Three Engines + Evidence-Bound Explanations
solution.implementation: Deterministic rules, semantic retrieval, and a generative judge are compared instead of relying on a single verdict. Explanations are bound to controls and evidence, and confidence describes grounding quality, not legal certainty. Wording is constrained so the system never claims legal compliance or regulatory approval.
solution.result: Every decision is human-auditable: reviewers see the flagged phrase, the control, the regulation, the detecting engine, and whether the engines disagreed.

timeline.title: Brief & Regulatory Framing
timeline.description: Analysed the Cambridge Spark 'Financial Regulation in an AI-Driven World' brief. Defined FCA-aligned positioning (COBS 4.2, Consumer Duty) and a curated control library rather than full Handbook ingestion.

timeline.title: Engines & Release Gate
timeline.description: Built the deterministic risk engine, semantic xRAG retrieval, the Gemini AI judge with simulated fallback, scoring, and the hybrid PACT release gate.

timeline.title: Evidence, Audit & Middleware
timeline.description: Added Evidence Pack generation, audit logging, session/customer tracking, robo-advice controls, and version-controlled middleware with reassessment flags.

timeline.title: Frontend & Sandbox
timeline.description: Built the React + Vite UI: review flow, PACT decision and Evidence Pack views, sandbox engine comparison, and governance/regulator dashboards.
